subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They thought technology made all decisions.”?
options: The rider said, "The map is useful, but it does not feel the road."
He said, "A wrong clock may feel helpful, but it teaches the wrong habit."
On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, "Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools.
The map led him to a narrow road behind the temple instead of the main gate.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They thought technology made all decisions. The rider said, 'The map is useful, but it does not feel the road.'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「He said, 'A wrong clock may feel helpful, but it teaches the wrong habit.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, 'Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The map led him to a narrow road behind the temple instead of the main gate.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They thought technology made all decisions. The rider said, 'The map is useful, but it does not feel the road.'」，答案為「The rider said, 'The map is useful, but it does not feel the road.'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The rider said, 'The map is useful, but it does not feel the road.'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
